title: Nvidia launches Open Secure AI Alliance; OpenAI, Google, Anthropic absent
summary: Nvidia formed a 30+ member coalition with Microsoft, IBM, Hugging Face and others to build open AI cybersecurity tools after the OpenAI breach.

title: Moonshot releases Kimi K3 open weights
summary: Moonshot published the 2.8-trillion-parameter Kimi K3 weights under a modified MIT license, letting organisations self-host a near-frontier model.
reason: Strong open-weights release narrows gap to closed frontier.
